targets.name: board_inputs
targets.note: Content-addressed copies of every board input. Kept while a board build of the window used them.

targets.name: feed_archive
targets.note: Exact bytes of each delivered US Money Index, events and news file. Accepted feeds and every source the events ledger cites are kept.

targets.name: feed_receipts
targets.note: Transport receipts, named by the same sha256 as the archived feed file.

targets.name: old_event_payloads
targets.note: Dated event payloads from before the delivery transport (to 17 Oct 2026); nothing reads them.

targets.name: etf_intelligence
targets.note: Per-ETF intelligence from each board build (AVS-MACRO-TRIAGE-001 T1). Dated files go with age; the latest file the triage join reads is kept.

not_targets.data/macro/archive: Macro packet archive: pipeline replays bind to each packet id and hash (build_macro_json WP0-06).
